items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Bob Bell and George Bell, two brothers.

ctx.x: Who else lived in that neighborhood? Were there other musicians living there?

Good question. Bird had lived – not the same time, but on the same street, down there. Kansas Fields, a drummer, had lived in that same block. A trumpet player from Duke Ellington’s band, deceased – not Cat Anderson. One of the others had lived there. A lot of guys had lived there. A lot of musicians lived in that area. That was Sugar Hill. Miles [Davis] lived around the corner. I was 149th. He was 147th. He lived – some people from East St. Louis – in fact the record Sippin’ at Bells, they had a restaurant…
Coming down from Boston, you must have brought your own drum set.
